experiences.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
experiences.description:
Lead third-party cybersecurity risk assessments for vendors supporting digital banking platforms, payment ecosystems, and cloud-based services by conducting inherent risk assessments, security due diligence reviews, and control evaluations aligned with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS, and SOC 2 requirements to support secure vendor onboarding and regulatory compliance.
Coordinate remediation activities for identified vendor security risks by partnering with Information Security, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and Business Owners to prioritize corrective actions, improving remediation turnaround by approximately one-third while ensuring adherence to enterprise risk governance standards.
Evaluate vendor security documentation including SOC 1, SOC 2 Type II reports, SIG and CAIQ questionnaires, penetration test reports, vulnerability assessments, BCP/DR plans, IAM controls, SSO, MFA, and encryption practices to determine residual risk and strengthen third-party security posture across critical banking services.
Utilize Microsoft Copilot and enterprise-approved generative AI capabilities to assist with reviewing security questionnaires, summarizing SOC reports, and preparing assessment documentation while ensuring all risk decisions, control validations, and remediation recommendations are reviewed and approved through established governance processes.
Prepare executive risk dashboards, maintain enterprise risk registers, and report vendor assessment status, remediation progress, and emerging third-party cyber risks across a portfolio of 100+ vendor assessments, enabling leadership to make informed risk-based business decisions.

experiences.title: Cybersecurity GRC / Third-Party Risk Analyst
experiences.description:
Managed the end-to-end Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) lifecycle by performing vendor intake, inherent risk classification, security due diligence, residual risk analysis, and periodic reassessments for technology, SaaS, and healthcare vendors supporting regulated business operations under HIPAA, GDPR, and enterprise security policies.
Assessed vendor security programs by reviewing SOC 1, SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, SIG and CAIQ questionnaires, vulnerability management reports, Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCP/DR) documentation, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and encryption controls to identify control gaps and recommend practical remediation plans.
Performed control mapping and compliance gap analysis against NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, HITRUST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA requirements to strengthen third-party governance and improve audit readiness across multiple regulatory initiatives.
Collaborated with vendors and cross-functional teams including Security Engineering, Compliance, Privacy, Procurement, Legal, and Business Owners to resolve identified control deficiencies, contributing to the successful closure of 120+ vendor risk findings while achieving more than 95% remediation within established service level targets.
Maintained centralized risk registers, assessment records, policy documentation, compliance evidence, and remediation tracking using ServiceNow, One Trust, Zen GRC, SharePoint, and Confluence, improving audit preparation efficiency by 28% and supporting successful internal and external compliance reviews.
Utilized enterprise-approved generative AI capabilities to assist with summarizing SOC reports, reviewing vendor security documentation, and identifying potential control exceptions while ensuring all assessments, risk ratings, and remediation recommendations were validated through established governance and analyst review processes.
